# FAQ-006 Engineering FAQ #6

Revision: Rev A

Q: What is the lube refill interval for the Heat Treat CNC turning center #1 (EQ-P1-L4-CN01)?
A: The way lube refill interval for Heat Treat CNC turning center #1 (EQ-P1-L4-CN01) is 40 hours. Follow the lubrication procedure in MM-P2-L1-SB03 for approved lubricant types and refill method.

Q: How often should shot media be topped up for the Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2 (EQ-P3-L1-SB02)?
A: The shot media top-up interval for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2 (EQ-P3-L1-SB02) is 45 hours. Use the media specification and handling steps referenced in SB-1031 when adding media.

Q: What torque is specified for the blast wheel liner bolts in Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01)?
A: The blast wheel liner bolt torque for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) is 100 N·m. Verify bolt condition and apply torque using a calibrated torque wrench per SB-1046 procedures.

Q: What torque is required for the blast wheel liner bolts in Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03)?
A: The blast wheel liner bolt torque for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03) is 50 N·m. Torque sequence and verification steps are documented in SB-1031 and SB-1046.

Q: What is the required torque for the main ram bolts on the Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03)?
A: The main ram bolt torque for Heat Treat hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P2-L4-HP03) is 1575 N·m. Only qualified personnel should perform this tightening; use a calibrated hydraulic torque tool and follow the bolt pre-load and inspection criteria in MM-P2-L1-SB03.

Related documents: MM-P2-L1-SB03, SB-1031, SB-1046
